# #411 — PROV-2: scaffold openbrain-provider package with config and logger

State: CLOSED

Part of #409.

Scaffold `openbrain-provider` as a workspace member. Structure only - no domain logic.

## Scope
- Member package: own `pyproject.toml`, hatchling backend, ruff/mypy/pytest config matching the fleet-bus member shape.
- `src/openbrain_provider/` with `__init__.py`, `config.py`, `logger.py`, `constants.py`.
- `config.py`: frozen dataclasses with `__post_init__` validation. This replaces the scattered env reads in the TS adapter - env is read in one place and frozen.
- `logger.py`: Loguru setup only, no business logic. `serialize=True`, `enqueue=True`.
- `constants.py`: module-level `UPPER_CASE`, no inline magic numbers/strings.
- `tests/` mirroring the module tree.

## Acceptance
- Every module opens with a docstring and `from __future__ import annotations`.
- Every function fully typed; `str | None`, never `Optional[str]`.
- Invalid config raises at construction, not at first use (fail closed at boot).
- `ruff format --check`, `ruff check`, `mypy` strict, `pytest` all green.
- No file over 250 lines at this stage.

## Non-goals
No request/receipt/dispatch/reflex/observation logic - those are PROV-3..8.
